title_en: The Stance of the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them) Regarding Insulting and Cursing the Sacred Matters of Others
description_en: The stance of the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them) regarding insulting and cursing the sacred matters of others. An excerpt from the program Debates in Creed, on seeking intercession through the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) in his life and after his death, by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari.
summary: This video clip outlines the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding respect for others' sacred symbols and avoidance of abuse.
